name: The Arkenstone // Seek the Heart

abilities.text: Search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

notes: The parser finishes the front face (anthem + end-step draw), so this extends it with the Adventure half only.

abilities.how: static: the board differs with and without this ability

issues: (Then exile this card. You may cast the artifact later from exile.) — the Adventure mechanic — expected Seek the Heart is cast from hand as its own {2}{W} sorcery; on resolution it is EXILED instead of going to the graveyard, and its owner may later cast The Arkenstone from exile. — scripted secondFace declares only {kind:'spell', effects:[search]}. No exile-on-resolution, no cast-from-exile permission, and parse.ts:1991 states outright that for adventure/split layouts 'the engine cannot cast that half' — the face exists for line accounting only. Nothing is listed under `ignore` either. — CR 715.3d, 715.3e

whole card (mana cost '{5} // {2}{W}') — expected The Arkenstone castable for {5}; Seek the Heart castable for {2}{W} — scripted The blind scenario still reports 'no legal action matched for P0 (have: pass)' — the engine offers no cast action for either half, so the card is unplayable while the script is stamped status=verified / sandbox ok. mode 'extend' adds nothing that repairs the front face. — CR 601.2f, 202.1

Search your library for a LEGENDARY creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. — expected filter = legendary creature card, revealed — scripted {types:['Creature'], supertypes:['Legendary']}, reveal:true — correct at the engine level (supertypes honored in matchesFilter); the render's 'search your library for a creature' is renderer lossiness. Unreachable in practice given the two issues above. — CR 205.4b

(Then exile this card. You may cast the artifact later from exile.) — expected Seek the Heart is cast as its own {2}{W} sorcery; on resolution it is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, and its owner may then cast The Arkenstone from exile. — scripted secondFace declares only {kind:'spell', effects:[search]} — no exile-on-resolution, no cast-from-exile permission, and parse.ts:1991 states outright that the engine cannot cast an adventure/split half. Nothing is recorded in `ignore` either. — CR CR 715.3d, 715.3e

The Arkenstone // Seek the Heart (mana cost) — expected The Arkenstone is castable for {5}. — scripted parseManaCost('{5} // {2}{W}') returns {generic:7, pips:['W']} (verified by running it), so the engine thinks the card costs {7}{W}. The blind scenario fails with 'no legal action matched for P0 (have: pass)' — neither half is castable — while the script is stamped status=verified. — CR CR 202.1, 601.2f

Search your library for a legendary creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. — expected Legendary creature card, revealed, to hand, shuffle. — scripted filter {types:['Creature'], supertypes:['Legendary']}, count 1, reveal, to hand — correct at the engine level (matchesFilter honours supertypes); the render's 'search your library for a creature' is renderer lossiness. Unreachable in practice given the two defects above. — CR CR 205.4

Creatures you control get +1/+1. / At the beginning of your end step, draw a card. — expected Claimed by the parser draft under mode 'extend'. — scripted Left to the parser and correct, but the script files no `covers` entries, so nothing records who claims the two front-face lines.
